archetypes.name: harness-oracles
archetypes.rationale: The plan is mostly test-harness work, so an extra reviewer should check that each proposed assertion can fail for the intended regression rather than merely increasing coverage text.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine whether the planned test additions create non-vacuous oracles for the specific harness gaps in the description. Check fixture setup, captured argv/log files, grep/count assertions, and mutation-sanity claims against the existing test harness structure so each new case would fail for the targeted defect and not pass accidentally. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: auth-state-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The issue spans Codex auth mode cleanup, stamp isolation, credential stripping, and fallback behavior across multiple harnesses, making contract drift likely.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan against the repository's existing Codex auth helper contracts and test harnesses for env-key versus login-mode behavior. Look for missing or incorrectly targeted steps around temporary CODEX_HOME cleanup, auth stamp isolation, symlinked auth fixtures, sentinel absence checks, fallback breadcrumbs, and legacy env_key stripping across all scoped files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
